content: पौर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [पुरे वसति शौषिको अण्] .²1 Relating to a city or town, produced in a town, civic. .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> Filling oneʼs own belly. .{@-रः@} .²1 A townsman, citizen, (<ab>opp.</ab> जानपद); <ls>Ku. 6. 41</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 10</ls>, <ls n="R. 2.">74</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 3</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 9</ls>. .²2 A term applied to a prince engaged in war under particular circumstances. .²3 A planet in a state of opposition to other planets. .{@-री@} The language of the servants in a palace. .{@-रम्@} A sort of grass (रोहिष).
